title: Batch yields (negatively skewed)
intro: The yield of eighteen batches of a chemical process, in percent (%) of the theoretical amount. A yield cannot be above 100 %, so most batches bunch up near the top, and a few poor batches make a long tail on the left. The mean (98.04 %) is below the median (98.65 %), and the skewness is negative, about −1.8.
